purpose: Routing index for CAST AI support answers. Match the case topic, then (1) read any matching local_knowledge entry before answering — these contain verified facts and human-reviewed reply templates — and (2) confirm current behavior against the official_sources in priority order when features, APIs, limits, or setup steps may have changed. Paths are relative to the repository root unless absolute.

official_sources.use_for: Product behavior, features, limits, setup steps. Key page: https://docs.cast.ai/docs/autoscaler-reference-node-labels-and-taints (reserved labels/taints). Fetch tip: every docs page is also served as clean Markdown by appending .md to the URL, and https://docs.cast.ai/llms.txt is a full page index — both verified working 2026-09.
Exact endpoint paths, request/response fields, auth requirements.
Helm charts, Terraform provider, castctl, agent source, examples, releases. If the user pastes a GitHub URL with a typo, resolve it against this org instead of trusting the malformed URL.
EU orgs (all Siemens orgs) must use the EU base URL, not https://api.cast.ai. A valid key against the wrong region is a common cause of unexplained 401s.

local_knowledge.verified_facts: Old cluster token stays valid for an extended period after rotation (observed >= 60 minutes, E2E-tested). No public revoke endpoint exists. Rotation endpoint: POST /v1/kubernetes/external-clusters/{clusterId}/token. Organization API keys are management-API only, NOT a substitute for the cluster token.
Human-reviewed customer reply for the token rotation case; reuse tone and structure.
Manual rotation commands per install topology; every secret and every component must be updated and restarted.

reply_exemplars.use_for: Gold-standard customer reply structure: lead with confirmed root cause + doc citation, state the supported contract, give a concrete migration path with YAML, list caveats, propose rollout order, end with verify commands.
Customer-facing draft style for rotation/incident topics.

related_guidance.use_for: Ops workflow, credentials, approvals, and hard boundaries for this repo. Read it when a case needs cluster or API actions rather than a written answer.
Repo-wide read-only posture, approval rules, and the canonical case workflow (receive -> check brain -> reproduce -> document -> reply).
